Updated entire script, including all configs and asset references, for full consistency.

Improved layout animation transitions for a smoother user experience.
Enhanced the visual quality and rendering of card displays.
Improved effect movement synchronization with card positioning.
Fixed incorrect bridge function logic to ensure proper integration.

Added server-side basket checkout (grouped items, price calculation, inventory space checks, and auto-refund on add failure).
Added Trading Card Exchange / Kiosk (TC Machine) UI (Buy Packs + Sell Collection screens).

Updated Grading UI to use a rich metallic gold color (#D4AF37) for the grading score circle.
Fixed a critical issue where cards could not be removed from the binder after a server restart.

Redesigned Shop and Buy UIs for a more modern look and smoother user experience.
Enhanced Grading Shop UI with updated visuals and improved interaction flows.
Upgraded TC Machine interface for intuitive card exchange and pack purchasing.
UPDATE ALL FILES - Significant changes to UI files (HTML/CSS/JS) and Server logic.
1.0.7: Split config into config.lua (core), configcards.lua (cards), and configshop.lua (shops/pricing); ensured fxmanifest loads in correct order.
Rebalanced Sell Shop base prices: large reductions for Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary across all brands.
Implemented pity-off booster pack rarity targeting: Epic ≈ 1/2000, Legendary ≈ 1/3000, Holo ≈ 1/4000, OriginalArt ≈ 1/5000.
Enabled OriginalArt as an independent rarity bucket on the server for selection and rules.
Updated global BoosterPacks cardsrarityRules to use direct weights for Epic/Legendary/Holo/OriginalArt (packGate disabled for these).
Kept Rare using packGate=true with chance=1% to preserve intended rare gating behavior.
Renamed non-card item names and image references to remove 'trading_cards_' prefix (cards unchanged).
1.0.8: CRITICAL hotfix: Updated server.lua and client.lua ONLY.
No other files were changed in this update.
Fixed an issue where card metadata was not being applied correctly in certain cases.
Important for ESX + ox_inventory users: existing cards without metadata must be removed.
Cards missing metadata can be identified by the lack of a % condition when hovering over the item in inventory.
Cards without metadata may cause unexpected issues with the Trading Card Book.
Newly obtained cards after this update will correctly apply metadata.
Apologies for the inconvenience — applying this fix is required to prevent further issues.
1.0.9: Added `Config.BindersEnforceBrand` (default: true). When enabled, binders will only accept cards that match the binder's assigned brand.
Added `Config.BindersDuplicatesCheck` (default: true). Prevents adding duplicate cards (same name) to the binder.
Added `Config.BindersChecklistEnabled` (default: true). Displays a checklist of cards in the book on the last page [20].
Updated `Config.Binders` table to include a `brand` parameter for each binder, enabling brand-specific card restrictions.
Added Live Checklist Updates: The binder checklist now automatically updates in real-time when cards are added.
Fixed an issue where card animations (sway, reveal) were not playing for users with 'reduce motion' enabled in Windows settings.
General performance improvements and code optimizations.
1.1.0: Fixed unclickable sell buttons on TC Machine UI by resolving CSS overlay issues (z-index conflicts).
Reorganized webhook configuration: merged separate 'Endpoints' and 'Colors' tables into a single 'DiscordHook' table for cleaner management.
Renamed webhook configuration table from 'Endpoints' to 'DiscordHook' across the entire script for consistency.
Added comprehensive Fivemanage logging integration alongside existing Discord webhooks.
Added configurable toggles in webhooks.lua: 'DiscordWebhooks', 'FivemanageWebhooks', and 'FivemanageDataset'.
Implemented automatic player identifier detection and metadata formatting for Fivemanage logs.
Added error handling for Fivemanage logging to prevent script crashes if the fmsdk resource is unavailable.
Enhanced webhook emission logic to support simultaneous logging to both Discord and Fivemanage, or either service independently.
Improved debug logging for webhook failures, including detailed error messages for troubleshooting.
All webhook payloads now include structured metadata for better log organization and filtering in external services.
1.1.1: This allows individual control over whether each shop's ped displays a map blip.
Updated client-side code to respect the new `blipenabled` flags.
General performance improvements and minor code optimizations.
No other files have been changed in this update
1.1.2: Configuration File Restructure: The main config.lua has been split into multiple files and moved to a new configs_settings folder. You must move your existing configcards.lua and configshop.lua into this new folder. All other files in the configs_settings folder must be replaced with the new versions.

Booster Pack Enhancements: Config.BoosterBoxes and Config.BoosterPacks have been moved to a new configs_settings/configbooster.lua file. Booster packs now support individual rarityRules, allowing for different odds per pack.

Inventory & Item Changes: An inventory check has been added to ensure players have enough space (6 slots) to open booster packs. The 2% condition removal from items has been implemented. A bug was fixed where cards would not correctly occupy an inventory slot.
New Features: A 'Sell Palsy' button has been added.
Performance: General performance improvements have been made.
1.1.3: Added new card brand Ammunation Elite
Added new card brand Full Throttle
Added new card brand Ls Legends
Added new card brand Ls Landmark
UI Visibility Rules: Stats now hide independently; descriptions remain if present; both hide when description is commented.
UI Consistency: Rarity badge is always shown, independent of stats visibility.
Bug Fixes: Resolved duplicate const redeclarations in Sell Shop and TC Machine UIs.
Inventory Install: Added Ammunation Elite & Full Throttle items to install list in correct order.
Config Tweaks: Updated pack thresholds/boosts and ensured effects toggles are respected.
Image Hosting: Switched for faster image loading, with local fallback (ui/i/).
UI Improvements: Added smooth fade-in/out transitions to Shop, Sell Shop, Grading Shop, and TC Machine menus.
Removed Effects: P_V and Trainer_Gallery_Holofoil effect types have been completely removed from the script.
Effect Overhaul: Significantly improved visual quality of Holofoil_Rare, Cosmos_Holofoil, Trainer_Gallery, Shiny_Vault, and Secret_Rare effects.
New Command: Added /jimgtrdingcardsshoweffect [effectName] to preview card effects in-game ONLY IF DEBUG true like the rest.
Performance Optimization: Implemented ImageCache system to prevent repeated file/config checks for shop images.
Menu Optimization: Drastically reduced lag when opening TC Machine and Sell Shop by optimizing inventory check.
Debug Safety: Added periodic (5min) console warnings (Client & Server) if Config.Debug is left enabled on a live server.
Booster Pack Fixes: Corrected effect mapping in Booster Packs so all card effects (Cosmos, Radiant, VMax, VStar, etc.) display properly.
Booster Animation: Added holographic shine animations to Booster Pack cards that sync with card movement and settle naturally over time.
Binder UI Polish: Improved card appearance in Binder - thicker borders (inwards) and better vertical alignment for rarity labels and card names.
Card UI 3D Overhaul: Added 3D depth to card elements. Card names now 'pop out' with a multi-layer drop shadow for a premium embossed look.
Rarity Badge Upgrade: Redesigned rarity badges with a 'Gemstone' style - inner highlights, shadows, and a subtle gradient to look like embedded jewels.
Stats Panel Redesign: Implemented a 'Holo-Glass' aesthetic for the stats area with frosted glass background, blur effects, and rounded 'capsule' stat boxes.
Card Frame Enhancement: Added a 'Double Stroke' border effect with inner metallic/white accents to give the card frame more physical detail.
Image Depth Effect: Applied a 'Layered Float' effect to card images, lifting them off the card body  and adding deep shadows to create a window/parallax illusion during rotation.
Binder Page Numbers: Added realistic 'Physical Page Corner' page numbers using serif fonts and italic styling, embedded into the top corners of the pages.
Binder Checklist Upgrade: Added a custom, slim, semi-transparent scrollbar to the checklist for better usability without breaking immersion.
Binder Card Scaling: Fixed and optimized the 'mini' card view in the binder. Stats and descriptions now scale down correctly (tiny fonts) to fit the grid without overflowing.
1.1.4: New Feature: Added Collector system. Collector rotates requested cards on a timer and supports Normal (condition threshold) and CVG (grade threshold) trade-ins with bonus payouts.
Collector Config: Added `configs_settings/configcollector.lua` with rarity filters and optional manual card lists for rotation selection.
Collector UI: Added a new Collector menu matching existing theme.
CVG Sell Shop: Added CVG category/tab in Sell Shop when player has graded slabs (grading_case).
CVG Visuals: CVG slabs now render using the same case/label/top overlays as grading UI, including date/serial/grade text and grade ring/number colors (red/silver/gold).
CVG Pricing: Added safer CVG pricing model to prevent easy profit from grading low-value cards; accounts for grading costs and caps profit unless high rarity/high grade.
Serial Numbers: Improved graded-case serial generation to avoid duplicates across restarts (persisted last serial + KVP registry).
Binder Data: Added optional `CardPositions` field to `configcards.lua` for binder/card placement support.
New Feature: Added CVG Binder (book-style UI) that stores graded slabs (grading_case) inside the binder metadata and allows add/remove by slot.
New Items: Added `cvg_binder` (CVG Binder) and renamed legacy `cvg_case` to `cvg_binder` with backward compatibility (old items still open the binder UI).
New Feature: Added `cvg_case_splitter` tool to break open a graded slab and return the contained card (slab destroyed).
Config: Added `Config.CVGCaseSplitter.consumeOnUse` toggle to optionally consume the splitter item on use.
Config: Added `Config.BrandURL` to change the brand URL shown across UIs (Shop/Sell/Grading).
Config: Added `Config.CVGBrandText` to rebrand the slab brand text and CVG slab category/tab names across UIs (visual-only branding).
TC Machine: Added graded slab selling support with its own category, correct slab rendering, and correct slot-based selling (fixes selling the wrong slab).
1.1.5: New Feature: Added Card Sleeves system (`card_sleeves`) to protect cards from condition loss when showing/trading.
Config: Added `Config.Sleeves` with overlay image + full protect toggle + protection percent + return/destroy toggle.
Sleeves UI: Sleeves render as an overlay on card view and; supports click-to-open 'Remove Sleeve' menu and removes sleeve metadata safely.
Sell/Collector: Optional sleeve return when selling or collector hand-in for sleeved cards (based on config).
Fix: Grading Shop ped is now independent from TC Machine enable (TC Machine only disables Shop/SellShop peds).
Fix: fxmanifest updated to allow NUI images in `.png/.jpg/.jpeg` in addition to `.webp`.
New Feature: Added Custom CVG Label Skins system. Use label items to apply custom label artwork to existing graded slabs (grading_case).
Config: Added `Config.CVGLabelSkins` with per-label `labelImage` plus `textColor` + `outlineColor` for better readability on custom labels.
Shop: Added CVG Label items to the shop under `CVG labels` category for easy purchase/testing.

New Content: Added 15 new CVG label designs (cvg_label_aetheric_sigil, arcane_circle, astral_dragon, celestial_gear, cosmic_phoenix, elemental_fusion, glacial_inferno, golden_valley, katana_street, mecha_hangar, nebula_drift, nebula_fox, sage_alignment, solaris_runes, winter_shrine).
New Feature: Single card view now uses hover-follow movement and glides back to neutral when mouse leaves the card.
New Feature: Added custom `label` support for shop item entries so store/TC machine can show clean names like 'JG Warlords Pack' instead of item ids.
Shop Naming: Added labels across the full main shop list (packs, booster boxes, books, accessories, CVG labels) for cleaner UI naming.
System: Added item-name fallback prettify logic to improve display names when no explicit label is provided.
Various optimizations and improvements have been added.
1.1.6: Shop UI: Added a basket drawer on the Trading Card Shop — add items, review totals, and checkout from one panel (no separate header checkout button).
TC Machine UI: Added the same basket drawer on the Buy Packs screen with checkout inside the drawer.
Shop daily stock: Optional per-item `dailyStock` on `Config.Shop.items` with global restock timer (`dailyStockRestockHours`). Stock shown in shop and TC buy UI; server tracks shared limits.
Sell / CVG economy: Sell and slab payouts now use stable, deterministic pricing from card condition (UI preview matches what the server pays).
Sell / CVG economy: Rebalanced `Config.CVG.gradeMultipliers` and added `Config.SellShop.sellPricing` (condition min/max, minimum payout, slab cap vs ungraded).
Sell / CVG economy: Removed default time-based sell jitter (`Config.SellShop.dynamic`); add it back in config if you want hourly price swings.
TC Machine: Shop ped, sell ped, grading ped, and vending props are fully independent — each uses its own `enabled` flag in config.
TC Machine: Vending prop spawn improved (waits for `jim_g_trading_cards_props`, retries model load, respawns when nearby).
Config: Added `Config.TcMachine.prompt` for drawtext mode when target is off.
Fix: TC Machine target no longer errors when opening the menu (`getCardData` load order).
Fix: Sell shop and TC sell list use server preview prices per inventory slot where applicable.
Backend: Global shop stock stored server-side basket buy/restock restores stock on failed adds.
Backend: Improved custom prop model loading for TC machines and related client stability.
1.1.7: New: Auto rarity — set `rarity = 'Auto'` on a card in configcards.lua to roll Normal/Uncommon/Rare/etc. per copy. Stored on `metadata.rarity`. Configure odds in `Config.AutoRarity.weights` (percentages should sum to 100).

New: Auto effect — set `effectType = 'Auto'` on cards that use `rarity = 'Auto'`. `Config.AutoRarity.effectRoll.chance` (%) can apply a random visual effect from `effectRoll.pool`; otherwise uses `default` (stored on `metadata.effectType`).
New: `Config.AutoRarity.packBucket` (default Normal) controls which booster pack slot can pull that card name. Rolled tier on the item is separate from pack slot rules.
New: `Config.AutoRarity.maxHighPerPack` (default 1) limits how many Rare+ Auto rolls can appear in one 6-card pack. Set to `false` to disable the cap.
Fix: Card sleeves `fullProtect = true` now blocks condition wear when using a card directly (not only when showing to another player).
Backend: Shared `conditionWearAmount()` for sleeve protection on all card-use wear paths.
Backend: Pack rewards pre-grant flow with locked pending metadata.
Note: Auto rarity/effect only run on cards explicitly set to `Auto` in configcards.lua. All other cards behave exactly as before.
1.1.8: Fix: tgiann inventory — booster boxes no longer fail or grab the wrong item from slot  when opening quickly or in succession.
Fix: Booster pack removal now uses the correct inventory slot, reducing failed opens and wrong-item issues.
Fix: Card and graded slab inventory tooltips now show useful details (name, rarity, condition or CVG grade) instead of appearing blank on tgiann.
New: Sell Shop bulk sell — added Sell All Cards and Sell All CVG buttons with live total value before you confirm.
New: TC Machine sell screen now includes the same Sell All Cards and Sell All CVG bulk buttons as the Card Buyer shop.
Fix: Trading Card Shop opens instantly on inventory without the previous 1 second freeze before the UI appeared.
Shop: Daily stock still loads in the background after the shop opens; sold-out badges update as soon as stock data arrives.
Backend: Booster box opens are tracked per slot with a reward lock to prevent double claims and overlapping opens.
New: CVG single slab view now follows the mouse with smooth 3D tilt, matching single card view.
UI: Removed the top-right X close button on CVG slab view; click anywhere outside the case to close, same as the card viewer.
WARNING: You must also update the `jim_g_trading_cards_props` resource to the latest version — old props cause broken or missing TC Machine textures and vending machine models.
Required update files: entire `ui` folder, `client/main.lua`, `server/main.lua`, and replace `jim_g_trading_cards_props` (ensure it starts before jim_g_trading_cards in server.cfg).
1.1.9: New: Deck Box system — use a deck item to view, add, and remove cards (up to 30 per box). Cards are stored on deck item metadata and keep full card metadata (condition, rarity, effects, sleeve state).
New: `Config.DeckBoxes` — 8 brand deck boxes (JG Warlords, Shin Genesis, Void Ether, Sands of Eternity, Ammunation Elite, Full Throttle, LS Legends, LS Landmark) with per-box image and brand.
New: `Config.DeckBoxesEnforceBrand` — when true, each deck only accepts cards matching that deck's brand.
New: `forcestatsonlycards` per deck box entry — when true, only battle-stat cards (Lv/HP/ATK/DEF) can be added; OriginalArt and no-stat cards are blocked in the add menu.

New: `Config.DeckBoxRules` — per-rarity composition limits for deck building (e.g. max Normal, max Legendary, etc.). Hard 30-card deck size is fixed in script and is not configurable. Missing rarity in rules = not allowed.
New: Optional per-deck rules override — add `rules = { ... }` on any `Config.DeckBoxes` entry to use custom rarity limits for that deck only.
New: Deck Box UI — deal-in animation when viewing, click a card to remove it back to inventory, undeal animation on close, holo effects on deck cards.
New: Deck boxes added to Trading Card Shop under the `Decks` category (`configshop.lua`).
New: Deck box items added to install lists — add the 8 `*_deck` items from `install/qb/qb_items.txt` or `install/ox/ox_items.txt` to your inventory.
Note: `forcestatsonlycards` and `Config.DeckBoxesEnforceBrand` are intended for use with the upcoming jim_g_trading_cards_game DLC/add-on.

Fix: Booster pack opens no longer grant all 6 cards the instant you use the pack — rewards are granted when the pack UI requests them after the tear animation, cutting server/inventory load when many players open packs at once.
Fix: Booster pack open cooldown on the server to stop pack-open spam.
Fix: Cannot open another booster pack while a previous pack still has unclaimed pending rewards.
Fix: Pending booster pack rewards are still granted if a player disconnects before closing the pack UI.
Fix: Booster pack UI close is locked until the card reveal animation has finished — click-outside and Escape no longer dismiss the pack too early during the reveal.
1.2.0: New: SQL storage for binder and deck box collections — card data is stored in MySQL (`jg_tc_container_cards`) instead of bloated item metadata JSON.
New: Binder and deck box SQL storage is always on — legacy `metadata.cards` auto-migrates on first open; empty containers remove their DB rows.
New: Slim item metadata — binders keep `binderId` + `currentSpread` + `cardCount`; deck boxes keep `deckId` + `cardCount`. Container IDs travel with the item on drop/trade.
New: `server/storage.lua` auto-creates the SQL table on resource start — first start logs "SQL injected", later restarts log "Database detected". Requires `oxmysql` (added as a dependency).
Note: Existing binders/deck boxes with cards in metadata migrate automatically the first time they are opened after updating.
Note: If oxmysql is missing, binders/deck boxes fall back to item metadata and the console shows a warning.
1.2.5: BREAKING — Collector removed: the built-in Collector NPC/UI/config is no longer inside jim_g_trading_cards. Collector is now the optional separate resource `jim_g_collector`.

Optional addon: install and start `jim_g_collector` after jim_g_trading_cards to restore collector trade-ins. Trading cards auto-detects it and logs `[jim_g_trading_cards] Detected jim_g_collector` when linked (silent if collector is not installed).
New: TC Machine DUI mode — set `Config.TcMachine.dui = true` to show the shop UI on the vending machine glass with immersive camera / native mouse. Set `dui = false` for the previous on-screen NUI.
New: `Config.TcMachine.dui_theme` (`light` / `dark`) and idle attract text via `Config.TcMachine.attract` for the glass screen.

New: Per-machine DUI occupancy lock — only one player can use a given TC machine prop at a time; other machines stay free. Busy machines notify: "This machine is in use and will be available shortly". Lock applies only when DUI is enabled (not ped shops / non-DUI mode).
New: `Config.DeckBoxPlayTypeRules` — max spell/trap per deck counted from card `playType` (default 3 each).
Locales: full UI/notify chrome wired to locale JSON keys (`ui/j/locale.js`, data-i18n). All locale files synced to the English key set.
Fix: Deck boxes with `forcestatsonlycards` now accept spell/trap cards (playType) in addition to battle-stat monster cards.
Fix: Card holo/shine now glides with the card tilt (including when the mouse leaves) instead of freezing on the last cursor position.
Fix: Radiant_Holofoil intensity toned down; removed the visible 4-corner tile seam on the foil pattern.
Change: Spell/trap cards use normal rarity (Uncommon, Rare, Holo) for pack pulls — not a separate Spell/Trap rarity.
Change: Debug test commands remain gated behind `Config.Debug`.
Note: Shop / Sell / Grading peds are unchanged and independent of TC Machine DUI locks.
WARNING: Keep `jim_g_trading_cards_props` updated and started before this resource for the vending machine / pack props.

Required update files: `fxmanifest.lua`, entire `ui` folder, entire `locales` folder, `client/main.lua`, `client/tc_machine_dui.lua`, `server/main.lua`, `server/storage.lua`, `configs_settings/config.lua`, `configs_settings/configshop.lua`, `configs_settings/configcards.lua`, `configs_settings/configbooster.lua`. Remove old `configs_settings/configcollector.lua` if present. Optional: install `jim_g_collector` separately.
1.2.6: New: Pack flip reveal — with `Config.NewPackOpenAnimation = true`, booster packs still tear/open as before, but cards come out face-down on their brand card back, then flip one-by-one left → right to show the front.
New: `Config.NewPackOpenAnimation` — set `false` to keep the classic face-up pack reveal (same as before this update).

New: `Config.CardBacks` — list of `{ brand = '...', backimage = '....webp' }` entries (images in `ui/i`). Used for pack flip reveal and single-card flip. Add more brands by copying a line. Use `{ brand = 'default', backimage = '...' }` as the fallback.

New: Single card view — open a card from inventory and click it to turn the whole card over to the brand back; click again for the front. Hover / tilt still works as normal; click outside still closes.
New: `Config.SoundVolume` (0.0–1.0) — master volume for all NUI sound effects (pack open, card reveal, binder, etc.).
Note: Brands without a `Config.CardBacks` entry use the `brand = 'default'` entry until you add a matching back image line.
Required update files: `fxmanifest.lua`, `configs_settings/config.lua`, `client/main.lua`, and the entire `ui` folder.
1.2.7: Fix: When a card is used/sanitized, inventory `metadata.stats` are overwritten from `Config.Cards` so rebalances apply to owned cards.

Change: `configcards.lua` — JG game brands (`jg_warlords`, `jg_shin_genesis`, `jg_void_ether`, `jg_sands_of_eternity`) monster stats (HP/ATK/DEF) fully rebalanced for battle flow. Each rarity now cycles offense / balanced / wall roles. Same-rarity offense ATK is tuned to meet or beat same-rarity balanced HP and wall DEF so guard walls do not lock the board (`too strong to attack`). Levels unchanged.

Change: Brand feel on those stats — Warlords baseline, Shin slightly sharper ATK, Void glassier, Sands tankier. Void Ether Uncommons that were accidentally Rare-tier power are corrected to Uncommon values.

Change: Per JG game brand — 6 Uncommon + 6 Rare cards converted to spell/trap (`playType` + `playEffectId`, no `stats`). Uncommon maps to spell/trap effects 1–3; Rare to 4–6. Pair with `jim_g_trading_cards_game` `config_spell_trap.lua`.
Note: Owned cards pick up the new stats/spell-trap defs after use/sanitize.
Fix: Opening a deck box quietly syncs card `metadata.stats` from `Config.Cards` only when they differ.

0.1.2: Expanded spell and trap effects — new spells (Fracture, Shatter, Cascade, Fortify, Wither, Vitalize, Emberbolt) and traps (Retaliate, Ambush, Bulwark, Siphon, Hexbolt) in `config_spell_trap.lua`, ready to pair with game-brand spell/trap cards.
Spell and trap face (up/down) is set by the card (`activateFaceUp`) — players no longer pick face when setting a spell or trap.
Traps must be armed before they can fire, so they are clearer and less confusing mid-match.

New trap option `armAtEndTurn`: true = short Activate window after End Turn (opponent/AI timer paused); false = highlight in your Attack phase and click to arm. Skip the window and the turn continues with the trap unarmed. AI arms automatically.
Activate prompt sits above the trap card/slot so artwork stays visible.
Forfeit is no longer a permanent top-right button — a small tab under your HP opens Forfeit when needed.
Added an Are you sure? forfeit prompt (Yes / No). Only you see it; the match does not freeze for the other player.
Improved table board layout — playmat and End Turn / status text sit cleaner on the wood so text is not stuck on the board border.
Smoother combat feedback — attack HP flash and hit timing feel tighter and more in sync with the strike.
Improved battle animations and UI timing for a cleaner, more responsive match feel.
Optional `HudControl` in config — paste your HUD hide/show exports so the external HUD can hide during matches and return when you leave the board.
Table presence board scaling improved so the mat fits more consistently across resolutions.
All locale files updated for forfeit confirm, trap Activate, and related UI text.
